title: data.pdf — section 134
text:
(2) A prohibition notice or prohibition order may not include terms which impose a
general obligation on service providers of intermediary services [F25falling within the
descriptions contained in] Article 12, 13 or 14 of the E-Commerce Directive—
(a) to monitor the information which they transmit or store when providing those
services, or
(b) actively to seek facts or circumstances indicating illegal activity when
providing those services.
